summary: Steve Elliott, 60, of Rockwell, Texas became overdue on a solo Longs Peak ascent via Clark's Arrow and the Loft Route in stormy weather with icy routes; reported overdue Saturday morning August 12 and found at 1:15 PM at the base of Clark's Arrow with hypothermia and exposure-related injuries.
location: Base of Clark's Arrow, Longs Peak, Rocky Mountain National Park
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain National Park Search and Rescue; Flight for Life; Northern Colorado Medivac
notes: NPS release dated 2017-08-12 says Elliott began the ascent Friday 2017-08-11; row date is the incident-start date. Name widely published.
